faqs.question: Which questions should a Head of Growth resolve before a target discussion in Consulting and Other Professional Services?
faqs.answer: Start with the organization's account of expertise-led advisory or delivery work provided to organizations or individuals, then clarify how the Head of Growth would coordinate growth experiments and commercial initiatives for a defined business. Ask how clients, practitioners, project teams, partners or owners, suppliers, and professional communities participate, which decisions are assigned to the role, and what evidence the employer wants to discuss. Record unanswered questions about location and working conditions before deciding whether to proceed.

faqs.question: Which parts of a Head of Growth career story fit the needs of Consulting and Other Professional Services?
faqs.answer: Select examples that show growth remit, customer insight, channels, collaboration, and attributable learning and relate them to the particular employer's service line, client or project context, team leadership, delivery model, and authorized outcomes. Explain the situation, the candidate's contribution, and what others did; then state why the experience transfers to Consulting and Other Professional Services without claiming every organization operates alike.

faqs.question: What should a Head of Growth prepare in writing before targeting Consulting and Other Professional Services?
faqs.answer: Document selection depends on the opportunity. A Head of Growth may draw from resume, growth portfolio, experiment summaries, and professional profile, but should foreground only material connected to service line, client or project context, team leadership, delivery model, and authorized outcomes. Keep the account consistent across versions and adjust emphasis without changing facts.

faqs.question: What should a Head of Growth approve before outreach in Consulting and Other Professional Services?
faqs.answer: First define the target and recipient, then agree the message and what may be disclosed. KOV can discuss research or outreach where included in the Head of Growth candidate's service scope; the candidate approves external communication. No one route should be assumed for all Consulting and Other Professional Services employers.

faqs.question: How should a Head of Growth compare title and remit in Consulting and Other Professional Services?
faqs.answer: A title cannot demonstrate fit by itself. The candidate should relate growth remit, customer insight, channels, collaboration, and attributable learning to the employer's stated needs, clarify how expertise-led advisory or delivery work provided to organizations or individuals shapes the work, and distinguish prior direct responsibility from capabilities that could transfer.

faqs.question: Will KOV secure a meeting for a Head of Growth with an employer in Consulting and Other Professional Services?
faqs.answer: No. KOV can discuss agreed research, positioning, and approved outreach for a Head of Growth candidate considering Consulting and Other Professional Services, but cannot promise a meeting or introduction. The employer decides whether to respond or hire, and the candidate authorizes any external communication.
